entries.source: E. Curzel and G. M. Varanini (eds.), La documentazione dei vescovi di Trento (XI secolo–1218), Bologna 2011; Document 28, pp. 154–157 (PDF pages 153–156); original: Archivio di Stato di Trento, Archivio Principesco Vescovile (APV), Sezione Latina, capsa 58, no. 1
entries.english: At Castel Firmiano, Frederick and Henry, counts of Eppan/Appiano, transfer Greifenstein castle and associated lands and rights to Salomone, bishop of Trento, for 1,400 Veronese pounds; the bishop confirms their older fiefs. Enricus de Roxenbacco appears among the witnesses, together with men associated with Weineck.

facts.content: appears among the witnesses to the conveyance.
facts.subject: Heinrich de Roxenbacco
